head_commit.message:
docs: Improve security demo with realistic intelligent tool approval UI

Updated POC plans based on realistic implementation constraints:

Changed: "Sandbox Real-time Visualization" → "Intelligent Tool Approval UI"

Reason:
- Real-time sandbox activity logging requires major backend changes
- Not feasible in 3-week POC timeline
- Current approval_needed protocol already supports what we need

New Approach (Day 9):

1. Enhanced Command Preview (WOW!)
   - Impact analysis: what files/paths will be accessed
   - Risk level auto-detection (safe/warning/danger)
   - Color-coded warnings (green/yellow/red)

2. Security Demo Scenarios (WOW!)
   Scenario A (Safe):
   - "Add authentication" → workspace files only
   - Approve → Success ✅

   Scenario B (Dangerous):
   - "Delete all files in /Users" → Warning dialog
   - Shows: Command will access system path
   - Shows: Current sandbox mode limits
   - Try anyway → Sandbox blocks → Clear error message
   - Executive sees: "Permission denied (sandbox)" 🤯

3. Sandbox Block Feedback (WOW!)
   - Clear error dialog when sandbox blocks action
   - Shows: Blocked path vs. Allowed workspace
   - Proves platform-native sandboxing works

Updated WOW Factor #6:
Before: 🔒 Sandbox real-time log (❌ not implementable)
After: 🔒 Intelligent tool approval + Impact analysis + Risk detection + Sandbox block proof (✅ realistic)

Benefits:
✅ Implementable in 3 weeks (uses existing protocol)
✅ Strong visual impact (color-coded warnings)
✅ Proves sandbox security (shows actual block)
✅ Executive-friendly (no technical jargon)

Demo Impact:
- Shows command BEFORE execution
- Analyzes risk automatically
- Demonstrates sandbox blocking
- All visible and understandable to non-technical executives

Updated Files:
- electron-ui-3week-detailed-plan.md (Day 9 tasks)
- electron-ui-poc-3weeks.md (Demo scenario 2)
